title: Apply lazy loading to photo column in admin directory

requirements.summary: Apply lazy loading to leader images in AdminDirectory photo column using the existing LazyImage component
acceptanceCriteria: All leader images in the photo column use the LazyImage component for lazy loading
Images maintain their existing circular masked preview appearance
Images load only when they enter the viewport
Placeholder or loading state is shown before images are loaded

file_operations.description: Replace direct img tags in the photo column with LazyImage component from frontend/src/components/LazyImage.tsx for all leader images (PM, state leaders, constituency leaders). Maintain the existing circular masking CSS classes and preserve all current visual styling. Verify the LazyImage component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure the component handles loading states and viewport detection for lazy loading of images.
